registered: 2026-10-14, before any stage-C code was written or run
latent: Q(t) = 100.41 + sum_m [r25_m * D25_m(t) + r45_m * D45_m(t)], t from the end of anchor 0. Month m (anchors_by_checkup): 25 C regime from anchor m end to the first visible row with chamber setpoint 45 after it (month 0: none), 45 C regime from there to anchor m+1 start (past months) or open (current month). D25_m(t), D45_m(t) = days spent in each regime up to t (clipped).
anchor_obs: Q(t_anchor_end_m) = 100.41 (m=0) or Q_fc,m + eps (m>=1), SD 0.05 Ah
step_obs: s_i = s0 + (Q(t_cv_end_i) - 100.41)/beta + delta*[setpoint 45] + A_m*exp(-(t_i - t_anchor_m)/tau_tr) + e, SD 0.15 Ah; steps in month m (after anchor m end, before anchor m+1 start)

priors.random_walk: r_m - r_(m-1) ~ N(0, 0.02^2) separately for the 25 C and 45 C rates

beta: V2's beta_a4 (A4 smooth 2 Ah, tau 1, beta0 1) at each cutoff (stage A failed, so not from A)
fit: linear-Gaussian MAP by weighted least squares with priors as pseudo-observations, at each cutoff on visible data only
prediction: Q(CK_k date 00:00); days after the last visible row are assigned to the 45 C regime of the current month if it has started, else to its 25 C regime; SD from the posterior covariance
gates: common gates against V2; calibration of predicted SD descriptive only
